notes: Lead: CTO Maya R. strong emphasis on predictable latency for EU customers; quote: 'can't accept tokens leaving EU for PII-containing tickets'
Background: mid-market helpdesk SaaS (30k customers) wants to move from hosted test API -> Dedicated for production of generative support assistant and document search
Initial engagement: started with hosted API trial in Jan; demo (2026-03-02) went well, latency benchmarks looked favorable for typical queries
Current ask: 2-week Dedicated POC to validate throughput, failover, and cost profile before procurement discussion

POC success criteria: sustain 50 req/s mixed chat+embed workload; p95 generation latency <=150ms for short queries (<=256 tokens); end-to-end SLA behavior under burst; cost target: unit economics must be demonstrably lower than hosted baseline
Models: prefer Llama-2-13B-8bit and Llama-2-70B-quant for higher-quality responses; fallback plan to 13B in constrained scenarios; want Redwood to show quantization impact and quality delta
Canary plan: start with 5% traffic to Dedicated pool for 48h, monitor error rate, latency, cost. Ramp 5->25->100 over 3 days if thresholds met

Routing/fallback: latency-first routing within region, then cost-tier fallback to cheaper variant; cross-region failover: primary us-east-1 (prod), secondary eu-west-1 for EU traffic; in failover, switch to 13B variant with cached prefixes
Automatic rollback: configured if error rate >2% or p95 latency increases >30% sustained for 10 minutes; SE to provide runbook snippets for automated rollback/alerting
Caching/batching expectations: Conversia wants prefix/KV cache replication and advice on batch size to hit latency targets; request: Redwood Optimize config recommendations prior to POC
Security/compliance: Okta SSO required; KMS integration (AWS KMS) for key management; SOC2 report required before procurement; retention controls: 90-day max, EU residency for EU customer data
Pricing: finance requested committed capacity options and break-even analysis vs hosted per-token rates. AE provided preliminary committed tiers; need official Dedicated pricing deck (linked)
Docs/links: security answers spreadsheet shared (drive link), pricing deck in drive, Fireflies transcripts attached
Quote from product lead: 'We need graceful degradation — better to return a smaller but correct answer than hallucinate under load'

Action items: SE (Priya) to produce POC config (batching, quant profiles) by 2026-03-12; AE (Jordan) to present committed pricing on 2026-03-15; Legal to complete residency addendum review by 2026-03-20
